definitions.gloss: to defeat; to beat; to overcome
definitions.explanation: To win decisively against an opponent in a competition, battle, or contest. Emphasizes a clear, forceful victory.

examples.japanese: {強豪|きょうごう}⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{負|ま}かした。
⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{負|ま}かして⟦{決勝|けっしょう}→決勝：04742_kesshou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: They beat their opponent and advanced to the finals.

examples.japanese: ⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{負|ま}かして⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦シェア→シェア：07882_shea⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They beat the rival company and captured market share.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb ({打|う}ち{負|ま}かす → {打|う}ち{負|ま}かさない → {打|う}ち{負|ま}かして). Transitive: takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark the defeated party.

USAGE:
The {打|う}ち〜 prefix adds emphasis and forcefulness, similar to English "beat soundly" or "trounce." Stronger than ⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧ (to win) and implies a more decisive victory.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧: to win (neutral)
- {負|ま}かす: to defeat (less emphatic)
- ⟦{倒|たお}す→倒す：01954_taosu⟧: to defeat, to bring down (also emphatic)
